tasks.title: Add adf.ToMarkdown() — ADF-to-Markdown converter
tasks.description:
Create `internal/adf/to_markdown.go` implementing `func ToMarkdown(raw json.RawMessage) string`. This is the inverse of `adf.Convert()` (Markdown→ADF in `internal/adf/converter.go`). Structurally similar to `ExtractText`/`extractNode` in `internal/adf/plaintext.go` but outputs Markdown syntax instead of plain text.

Signature mirrors `ExtractText`: `func ToMarkdown(raw json.RawMessage) string`.

Node mapping (only types defined in `internal/adf/nodes.go`):
- `TypeDoc`: recurse children, `\n` between blocks
- `TypeHeading` (attrs.level): `#` x level + space + inline content
- `TypeParagraph`: inline content + `\n\n`
- `TypeBulletList`/`TypeListItem`: `- ` prefix (nested: 2-space indent per level)
- `TypeOrderedList`/`TypeListItem`: `1. ` prefix (nested: 3-space indent per level)
- `TypeCodeBlock` (attrs.language): fenced code block with language
- `TypeBlockquote`: `> ` prefix per child paragraph
- `TypeRule`: `---\n`
- `TypeText` + marks: `**bold**`, `*italic*`, `` `code` ``, `[text](href)`, `~~strike~~`
- `TypeHardBreak`: `\n`
- `TypeText` (no marks): raw text

Unknown node types: concatenate text content of all child text nodes (same as `ExtractText` behavior).
Empty/nil input: return empty string. Invalid JSON: return raw string as fallback (same as `ExtractText`).
successCriteria: ToMarkdown correctly converts each ADF node type to its Markdown equivalent
Unknown node types fall back to ExtractText behavior (concatenate child text)
Empty/nil input returns empty string
Invalid JSON returns raw string as fallback
Typecheck passes

tasks.title: Create internal/markdown package — frontmatter.go and filemap.go
tasks.description:
Create new package `internal/markdown/` with two files.

**`internal/markdown/frontmatter.go`:**
- `Frontmatter` struct with YAML tags (key, id, type, summary, status, priority, labels, parent, assignee, assignee_id, reporter, reporter_id, project, created, updated). Use `yaml:"field,omitempty"` for optional fields.
- `func IssueToMarkdown(issue api.Issue) ([]byte, error)` — converts an `api.Issue` to markdown bytes. Output: YAML frontmatter between `---` delimiters + body (raw Markdown description via `adf.ToMarkdown()`). Import path for api types: `github.com/endgame-build/jira-cli/internal/api`. Import `gopkg.in/yaml.v3` for marshaling.

**CRITICAL field mapping** — `api.IssueFields` uses nested structs, NOT plain strings. All require nil checks before access:
- `frontmatter.Type` ← `issue.Fields.IssueType.Name` (IssueType is `*api.IssueType`)
- `frontmatter.Status` ← `issue.Fields.Status.Name` (Status is `*api.Status`)
- `frontmatter.Priority` ← `issue.Fields.Priority.Name` (Priority is `*api.Priority`)
- `frontmatter.Project` ← `issue.Fields.Project.Key` (Project is `*api.Project`)
- `frontmatter.Parent` ← `issue.Fields.Parent.Key` (Parent is `*api.IssueParent`)
- `frontmatter.Assignee` ← `issue.Fields.Assignee.DisplayName`, `frontmatter.AssigneeID` ← `issue.Fields.Assignee.AccountID` (Assignee is `*api.User`)
- `frontmatter.Reporter` ← `issue.Fields.Reporter.DisplayName`, `frontmatter.ReporterID` ← `issue.Fields.Reporter.AccountID` (Reporter is `*api.User`)
- `frontmatter.Labels` ← `issue.Fields.Labels` ([]string, no nil check needed)
- `frontmatter.Created` ← `issue.Fields.Created`, `frontmatter.Updated` ← `issue.Fields.Updated` (plain strings)
- `frontmatter.ID` ← `issue.ID`, `frontmatter.Key` ← `issue.Key`, `frontmatter.Summary` ← `issue.Fields.Summary` (plain strings)

See `internal/api/types.go` for all type definitions.

**`internal/markdown/filemap.go`:**
- `func IssuePath(issue api.Issue) string` — returns `{ProjectKey}/{IssueKey} - {SanitizedSummary}.md`. ProjectKey comes from `issue.Fields.Project.Key` (nil-check: if nil, fall back to extracting project prefix from `issue.Key`).
- `func SanitizeFilename(name string) string` — replaces `/\:*?"<>|` with `-`, collapses multiple spaces, trims whitespace, max 100 chars

This package sits between `api` and `shared` in the layer hierarchy — it imports `api` types and `adf` package but NOT `factory` or commands.
successCriteria: Frontmatter struct has all fields with correct YAML tags
IssueToMarkdown produces correct YAML frontmatter + markdown body
IssueToMarkdown nil-checks all pointer fields (IssueType, Status, Priority, Project, Parent, Assignee, Reporter) before accessing .Name/.Key/.DisplayName
IssuePath returns correct relative path format
SanitizeFilename handles all special characters and length limits
Typecheck passes

tasks.title: Create jira issue export command
tasks.description:
Create `internal/cmd/issue/export.go` implementing the `jira issue export` command.

Follow the command pattern from `internal/cmd/issue/create.go`: `ExportOptions` struct + `NewCmdExport(f *factory.Factory) *cobra.Command` + `runExport(opts *ExportOptions) error`.

**Flags:**
- `--project` / `-p`: project key filter (resolve via `resolveProject()` from same package — it's unexported in `create.go`)
- `--jql`: raw JQL (overrides --project, skip project resolution entirely)
- `--output-dir` / `-o`: root output directory (default `.`)
- `--limit`: max issues to export (0 = all)

**Flow (streaming):**
1. Build JQL: if `--jql` set use directly; otherwise resolve project and build `project = "PROJ" ORDER BY key ASC`
2. Iterate pages using `client.SearchIssues(ctx, searchOpts)` with `Fields: []string{"summary", "description", "status", "issuetype", "priority", "labels", "parent", "assignee", "reporter", "project", "created", "updated"}`, `MaxResults: 50`
3. For each issue: compute path via `markdown.IssuePath(issue)`, convert via `markdown.IssueToMarkdown(issue)`, write via temp-then-rename (or skip if `--dry-run`)
4. Report progress to `f.IOStreams.ErrOut`: `Exported N issues...`
5. Output: text → `Exported N issues to {dir}`, JSON → `OutputMutation` with ok/exported/output_dir/files, dry-run → `OutputDryRun`

Import `internal/markdown` package. Reuse `resolveProject()` and `output.NewFormatter`/`OutputMutation` from existing code.

JQL built correctly from --project or --jql
Error if neither --jql nor --project/config-default provided (via resolveProject)

Temp-then-rename write pattern used

Progress reported to stderr
JSON output uses OutputMutation format

tasks.title: Create jira issue import command
tasks.description:
Create `internal/cmd/issue/import.go` implementing the `jira issue import` command.

Follow the command pattern: `ImportOptions` struct + `NewCmdImport(f *factory.Factory) *cobra.Command` + `runImport(opts *ImportOptions) error`.

**Flags:**
- Positional args: file paths
- `--dir` / `-d`: import all .md files from directory (mutually exclusive with positional args)
- `--force`: overwrite on conflict (default: error)

**Flow:**
1. Collect files from args or `--dir` via `markdown.ParseDir()`; parse via `markdown.ParseFile()`
2. Validate: key + summary required; project + type required for creates; reject temp-to-temp parent refs (`^[A-Z]+-NEW-\d+$` parent on a temp-key file → `CLIError` with `VALIDATION_ERROR`)
3. Separate creates (`IsCreate()`) vs updates
4. **Creates** (sequential): build `api.CreateIssueInput.Fields` map following the pattern in `create.go:108-184`:
   - `fields["project"] = map[string]interface{}{"key": frontmatter.Project}`
   - `fields["issuetype"] = map[string]interface{}{"name": frontmatter.Type}`
   - `fields["summary"] = frontmatter.Summary`
   - Description: convert via `adfDoc, err := adf.Convert(description)` (handle error like `create.go:117-121`) then set `fields["description"] = adfDoc` — set the `*adf.Node` directly in the map (NOT json.Marshal). This matches `create.go:123`. The Node struct has json tags so CreateIssueInput marshaling handles it.
   - Priority/labels/parent/assignee if set (see `create.go:146-162` for exact map shapes)
   - Call `client.CreateIssue(ctx, input)` → get `CreatedIssue{ID, Key}`
   - Record mapping: `tempKey → realKey`
5. **Updates** (sequential): fetch current issue via `client.GetIssue(ctx, key, nil)`, conflict check (compare `frontmatter.Updated` string vs `currentIssue.Fields.Updated`), build `api.EditIssueInput.Fields` — always send summary, description (if present), priority, labels, assignee_id (same field shapes as creates; do NOT diff against current values, just send what's in frontmatter — matches `edit.go` pattern), call `client.EditIssue(ctx, key, input)`. Note: `type`, `project`, `parent`, `status` are NOT sent on update (see field behavior table in plan doc).
6. Output: text summary with per-issue lines + browse URLs via `client.BrowseURL(key)` (see `create.go:200`), JSON → `OutputMutation` with results array and summary counts.

**Validation errors:**
- No args AND no --dir → `errors.NewValidationError("specify files or --dir")`
- Creates missing `project` or `type` in frontmatter → `errors.NewValidationError(...)`
- Temp-to-temp parent → `errors.NewValidationError(...)`

**Error handling:** Parse errors → `errors.NewValidationError()`, API errors propagated (already CLIError from `mapHTTPError`), conflicts → `errors.NewConflictError()` (exit code 8). Stop on first error.

All error constructors are in `github.com/endgame-build/jira-cli/internal/errors` (import as `clierrors`).
successCriteria: Import command registered with correct flags and help text
Positional args and --dir are mutually exclusive
No args and no --dir returns validation error
Creates require project and type in frontmatter, error if missing
Creates build correct CreateIssueInput — description set as *adf.Node directly (not json.Marshal'd), matching create.go:123 pattern
assignee_id maps to {accountId: ...}, missing assignee_id skips field
Temp-to-temp parent references rejected with VALIDATION_ERROR
Updates do NOT send type, project, parent, or status fields (read-only or out of MVP scope per plan)
Updates fetch current issue and perform conflict check
--force overrides conflict detection
Stop-on-first-error behavior
JSON output includes results array with action/key/temp_key/url and browse URLs from client.BrowseURL()
Typecheck passes
